messages:
devon: heads-up — panel snapshot on the eval board isn't updating after a CI dry-run, still shows old sparkline values. re-ran same job twice and UI didn't change.
maya: saw that too on staging earlier, thought it was a fluke.
chris: any network logs? could be frontend caching keyed wrong.
devon: pasted the xhr response when I hit refresh:
```json
GET /api/evals/EV-1234/snapshot -> 200 {"eval_id":"EV-1234", "run_seq": 42, "snapshot_ts": 1680000000, "series": [...] }
```
maya: frontend stores snapshot in localStorage under `eval_snapshot_EV-1234`, so if run_seq doesn't change key stays the same.
ci-bot: Deployment finished: web-frontend v3.12.2 to staging (build 2023-11-02T15:44Z) :rocket:
olivia: quick theory — runner dry-runs don't bump run_seq (they're idempotent), so the backend returns identical metadata and the UI doesn't evict the cached snapshot.
chris: makes sense. options: increment run_seq on dry-run, or change cache key to include something that changes on each run (commit hash / run_id).
devon: i'd prefer keeping run_seq semantics and adding commit_sha to the cache key. minimal risk. proposal: `${eval_id}-${run_seq}-${commit_sha.slice(0,8)}`
maya: also add a short unit test that simulates two successive dry-runs and asserts the UI fetches the fresh snapshot.
chris: I'll add an integration CI step to exercise the dry-run path so this doesn't slip through again.
devon: opened PR #7894 with frontend + api tweak, includes test and changelog note. linking now.
olivia: API change LGTM — added a note about backward compat for existing cached keys. i'll monitor staging after the next deploy.
maya: thanks — QA will verify after staging run, marking to follow up. :thumbsup:
